convert-jeffresc report
=======================

Adoption will WRITE every field below onto the live objects in Authentik. Before turning
dryRun off, read each object's Ready condition (reason AdoptionDryRun lists `field: old -> new`)
and edit the spec until the only listed changes are ones you intend.

AuthentikApplication ns/demo
  files: authentikoauthprovider-demo.yaml, authentikapplication-demo.yaml
  unset in JeffResc, written explicitly with JeffResc's default (keeps the live value):
    - provider.clientType = confidential
    - provider.accessCodeValidity = minutes=1
    - provider.accessTokenValidity = minutes=5
    - provider.refreshTokenValidity = days=30
    - provider.subMode = hashed_user_id
    - provider.issuerMode = per_provider
    - provider.includeClaimsInIdToken = true
    - application.openInNewTab = true
    - application.policyEngineMode = any
  defaulted by this operator's CRDs (no JeffResc equivalent; adoption writes them):
    - provider.grantTypes = [authorization_code, refresh_token]
    - provider.refreshTokenThreshold = seconds=0
    - provider.logoutMethod = backchannel
    - provider.redirectUris[*].matchingMode = strict, .type = authorization (what JeffResc sent for plain URIs)
    - application.metaHide = false
  notes:
    - provider.scopes is explicitly empty in JeffResc: emitted as scopes: [] (the provider keeps only the propertyMappings)
    - provider.signingKey is explicitly empty in JeffResc: omitted, so adoption keeps the live signing key
    - Secret demo-oauth keeps its name: this operator refuses to overwrite the Secret JeffResc owns (SecretConflict) until the old one is deleted with the old CR; see the runbook, or convert with --secret-suffix
    - JeffResc labels its Secret goauthentik.io/application=<name>; this operator does not set that label

Adopt-only mode: createIfMissing is not set, so a missing match target is reported as
AdoptionTargetNotFound and nothing is created. Once every app is migrated and SSO login is
verified, leave adopt-only mode: set spec.adoption.enabled: false on every converted
provider and application (final runbook step in docs/migration-from-jeffresc.md).
